title: Reinforcement Learning for Symbolic Equation Solving
abstract: arXiv:2608.30162v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present a reinforcement-learning agent that solves symbolic equations step by step, covering both nonlinear closed equations (radicals, exponentials, trigonometric) and a controlled class of restricted-open families requiring a change of variables (CoV) such as completing the square. We cast algebra as an MDP with a dynamic action space and a tree-structured policy (TreeMLP). The main policy learns from reward alone with no supervised solution traces; the CoV substitution comes from a supervised generator interchangeable with a CAS call. On closed equations the agent matches the prior best on CommonCore (0.93 greedy vs. ConPoLe's 0.925) under a single policy. On four hand-designed restricted-open families (quadratic, cubic, quartic, exponential) it reaches 0.79 beam / 0.67 greedy, exceeding the strongest non-learned search (A-star, 0.64). translated_title: 基于强化学习的符号方程求解
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种能够逐步求解符号方程的强化学习智能体，其求解范围既涵盖非线性封闭方程（根式、指数、三角函数方程），也涵盖一类需要变量代换（CoV）的受限开放方程族（例如配方法）。我们将代数问题建模为一个具有动态动作空间和树形结构策略的马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）。主策略仅依靠奖励信号进行学习，不使用任何监督式的解题轨迹；变量代换则来自一个可与计算机代数系统（CAS）调用互换的监督生成器。在封闭方程上，该智能体在单一策略下达到了此前最佳水平（在 CommonCore 数据集上贪心解码准确率为 0.93，对比 ConPoLe 的 0.925）。在四个手工设计的受限开放方程族（二次、三次、四次、指数方程）上，它达到了 0.79 的束搜索准确率 / 0.67 的贪心解码准确率，超过了最强的非学习搜索方法（A* 搜索，0.64）。学习到的变量代换时机仅在指数方程族上具有实质意义，该方程族是唯一需要嵌套变量代换的一族……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于树形结构策略和动态动作空间的强化学习智能体，无需监督解题轨迹即可逐步求解符号方程，在封闭方程上追平现有最佳方法，并在需要变量代换的受限开放方程族上超越了 A* 搜索等最强非学习基线。
en_tdlr: A reinforcement learning agent with a dynamic action space and tree-structured policy solves symbolic equations step by step without supervised solution traces, matching the prior best on closed equations and outperforming A-star search on restricted-open equation families requiring change of variables.
